title: Target-directed closure and smaller typed checking for iPRA
overall_status: Two proved local refinements; a new globally smallest axiomatization was not established.

mathematical_result.new_primitive: QE uses only t, requesting E(s) when the matrix is an equation and t is literally S(s), and requesting the zero instance otherwise.
mathematical_result.bootstrap: W(t)=I(0,t;u.0) recovers arbitrary-target atomic closure without an arithmetic orbit identity.
proved: One-step progress and arbitrary-target anchored closure
Capture-free numerical substitution with explicit target-shape repair
Full numerical transport and homogeneous binder congruence
Exact consequence equivalence with the inherited orbit calculus for all Eq/Q/D formulas and arbitrary contexts
Bi-interpretability and equiconsistency with full first-order iPRA by composition with attributed inherited translations
Whole numerical domains, actual equality, both numerical composite graphs x=y, and both full formula composites
mathematical_result.qualification: Smaller than the orbit comparator; larger than the existing witness-sensitive comparator. No new overall minimum.

implementation_result.theory: Existing conditional Choice-DI, with source-restricted transport; full Eq/Q/D public syntax
unchanged: Both introduction choices at every witness
implementation_result.new: Lexical integer/list validation before JSON decoding, removal of redundant exact-type tests, and separately measured Boolean error factoring
implementation_result.equivalence_scope: Identical ideal finite certificate acceptance; resource failures and error messages can differ.
